long_biography.plain_text:
Control of Dunav Tours gave Ivan Totev Radev and his Union Group partners a platform in European river cruising. The company combines ship ownership with itineraries across the Danube, Rhine and Moselle, while related holdings produce renewable electricity and develop commercial property. Union Group operates these businesses through dedicated subsidiaries.

Radev’s role is board-level and strategic. He chairs Union Group, sits on the board of Dunav Tours and remains a principal shareholder in the holding company. Before the current portfolio, he chaired Unionbank’s supervisory board and later its management board. The structure keeps the operating companies separate while the founders retain governance and capital-allocation roles.

uncertainties.detail: The exact three-part upstream name matches central-bank records, official company pages and ownership disclosures for the Unionbank and Union Group principal. The full name and business history distinguish him from former Plovdiv mayor Ivan Totev, Bulgarian President Rumen Radev and unrelated technology professionals. No public source reviewed names the owner of the upstream current vessel, so the vessel relationship remains private database context and is not used in biographies, classifications or tags.

The Finance & Investments conclusion is not inferred from the words banker or chairman. IFC, Bulgarian National Bank and Chamber of Commerce records document Radev's direct and indirect Unionbank equity, while the company history documents the bank sale and reinvestment of its proceeds. This establishes both a personal founder stake and the transaction linking it to the current holding-company assets.

Union Group's current site directly identifies Radev as a 25% shareholder and chairman. Its history and independent PwC material establish multiple sustained sectors: commercial property, renewable energy and river-cruise ship ownership. Diversified is a medium-confidence inference because these unrelated divisions are material and no reliable source ranks one as dominant; exact current asset values and segment contributions are private.

Radev and his brother Svetoslav are documented as two of four partners who co-founded the financial businesses; the core asset did not predate Ivan's documented participation. No inheritance or transfer from his brother or another relative is supported. Broad Self-made therefore rests positively on co-creation and personal founder equity, while the source of starting capital and any wider family advantage remain unresolved and prevent a narrower subtype.

The historical Unionbank interest was sold, so former banking roles alone do not determine the current relationship. Founder remains appropriate because the official current profile documents Radev's 25% economic stake and chairmanship in Union Group, a holding company he also co-founded and which continues to own the reinvested operating portfolio.

Two same-publisher birthday notices associate the Union Group chairman with 4 March, but no equivalent primary or independently corroborating source was found and no reliable birth year or birthplace was established. No birth proposal is therefore made. Secondary nationality and secondary residence also remain unsupported.

Searches for Ivan Radev returned LinkedIn profiles belonging to unrelated technology and professional-services workers. No identity-secure personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, Wikipedia page or personal website was found. Only the official Union Group company website is proposed because it directly identifies his ownership and leadership.

The mandatory exact Forbes-profile searches were performed first after inventory using the full three-part name and business-context variants. No dedicated profile matched the Unionbank co-founder and Union Group chairman, so no Forbes social link is proposed.

Banking is the single minimum useful active tag because founder equity, strategic control and executive leadership make it the defining wealth-creation industry. Its temporal scope is former but defining after the complete bank exit. Cruise industry, renewable energy and commercial real estate remain material portfolio facts, but assigning all three would over-tag one diversified holding and could imply unsupported sector dominance.
